contract: pebble(dag, fast_memory_budget) -> list of [operation, vertex], with operations load/store/compute/delete. dag has topologically ordered parents and output vertices. Inputs start blue, all outputs must finish blue; every red value consumes one fast-memory slot, including newly computed results. Recomputations allowed; at most20000 operations. Score mean transfers / naive schedule on three layered DAGs; exact state-machine verification.
